title: Dnes platím ja
topic: two friends order in a café, get each other's drinks and one of them forgets his wallet

sentences.sk: Je pondelok popoludní.
sentences.en: It is Monday afternoon.

sentences.sk: Lucia a Peter sedia v kaviarni pri okne.
sentences.en: Lucia and Peter are sitting in a café by the window.

sentences.sk: Dobrý deň! Čo si dáte?
sentences.en: Hello! What will you have?

sentences.sk: Ja si dám čaj s mliekom, prosím.
sentences.en: I'll have tea with milk, please.

sentences.sk: A ja chcem kávu a vodu, prosím.
sentences.en: And I want coffee and water, please.

sentences.sk: Máme aj dobrú polievku a čerstvý koláč.
sentences.en: We also have good soup and fresh cake.

sentences.sk: Aký je to koláč?
sentences.en: What kind of cake is it?

sentences.sk: Jablkový. Je veľmi dobrý.
sentences.en: Apple. It is very good.

sentences.sk: Tak si dám polievku a koláč.
sentences.en: Then I'll have the soup and the cake.

sentences.sk: Ja nechcem nič jesť.
sentences.en: I don't want to eat anything.

sentences.sk: Marek prinesie čaj, kávu a vodu.
sentences.en: Marek brings the tea, the coffee and the water.

sentences.sk: Ale Lucia dostane kávu a Peter dostane čaj.
sentences.en: But Lucia gets the coffee and Peter gets the tea.

sentences.sk: Peter, to je tvoja káva, nie moja!
sentences.en: Peter, that is your coffee, not mine!

sentences.sk: A toto je tvoj čaj!
sentences.en: And this is your tea!

sentences.sk: Lucia a Peter sa smejú.
sentences.en: Lucia and Peter laugh.

sentences.sk: Polievka je horúca a koláč je sladký.
sentences.en: The soup is hot and the cake is sweet.

sentences.sk: Lucia, ten koláč je výborný. Chceš aj ty?
sentences.en: Lucia, this cake is excellent. Do you want some too?

sentences.sk: Áno, prosím. Máš pravdu, je veľmi dobrý.
sentences.en: Yes, please. You're right, it is very good.

sentences.sk: Potom Peter zavolá čašníka.
sentences.en: Then Peter calls the waiter.

sentences.sk: Účet, prosím.
sentences.en: The bill, please.

sentences.sk: Polievka, koláč, káva, čaj a voda. Tu je účet.
sentences.en: Soup, cake, coffee, tea and water. Here is the bill.

sentences.sk: Peter hľadá peňaženku, ale nemôže ju nájsť.
sentences.en: Peter looks for his wallet, but he can't find it.

sentences.sk: Lucia, moja peňaženka je doma!
sentences.en: Lucia, my wallet is at home!

sentences.sk: To nič. Dnes platím ja.
sentences.en: Never mind. Today I'm paying.

sentences.sk: Ďakujem! Zajtra platím ja a dáme si zase koláč.
sentences.en: Thank you! Tomorrow I'm paying, and we'll have cake again.

sentences.sk: Dobre. Ale zajtra nezabudni na peňaženku!
sentences.en: All right. But tomorrow don't forget your wallet!

recap: Lucia and Peter order tea, coffee, soup and cake in a café. The waiter mixes up their drinks, and when the bill comes Peter's wallet is at home, so Lucia pays.

dám.gloss: I will have (dať si: to have, to order)

dáme.gloss: we will have (dať si: to have, to order)
